node.statement: Compression-map identity: by def-compressed-corner, Co_{P,Q}=theta(B_{P,Q}) and Co_{P_n,Q_n}=theta(B_{P_n,Q_n}). The raw-operator identity and theta naturality therefore give Co_{P_n,Q_n}=theta(iota_n(B_{P,Q}))=iota_n(theta(B_{P,Q}))=1_{M_n} tensor Co_{P,Q}.
